lines.5: 「Ellie, what have you been sneaking around doing while I was away at that meeting!? I knew something was fishy...!」
lines.6: 「You found someone to fill in... But what else could I do? Usually you're glued to Leo's side.」
lines.7: 「I was considerate enough to spare you the actual scene... You silly Yoppi.」
lines.9: 「Leo! You and I are dating, aren't we?」
lines.10: 「So you aren't getting back together with Ellie, right?」
lines.11: 「I think you're wasting your time, Yoppi.」
lines.12: 「He's been completely wrapped around my finger since summer break.」
lines.14: 「You said you'd go out with me, remember?」
lines.16: 「You did accept her confession, Leo. I suppose that makes you responsible, too.」
lines.17: The Princess held out her hand to me as well.
lines.18: 「Choose whose hand you're going to take.」
lines.21: But if I chose her here, what kind of person would that make me?
lines.22: 「Don't decide with your head. Choose the one your heart already has!」
lines.24: She was right. I absolutely couldn't keep acting this dishonestly.
